key_findings: 5xFAD mice show reduced inflammatory mechanical allodynia, reduced ACC neuronal firing and dendritic spine loss in ACC pyramidal neurons.
Rac1 or actin polymerization inhibition in WT mice mimics spine loss, delayed firing and reduced pain response; ChR2 activation of ACC CaMKII+ neurons rescues pain response in 5xFAD.
